create_discrete_gaussian_schedule: create a DiscreteGaussianSchedule instance with a cosine beta schedule for 1000 diffusion timesteps
build_cosine_beta_schedule: build a cosine beta schedule tensor for a given number of diffusion timesteps using cosine_beta_schedule
build_linear_beta_schedule: build a linear beta schedule tensor for a given number of diffusion timesteps using linear_beta_schedule
test_q_sample_forward_diffusion: test the q_sample method to compute noisy data xt from clean data x0 and noise at timestep t
test_q_posterior_reverse_diffusion: test the q_posterior method to compute posterior mean and log variance for reverse diffusion at timestep t
